text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - Repeated cuda.alloc_fail events in pool infer-west2a. 74 events in last 5m. Affected model: redwood/gpt-medium-int8 (west2). PD: https://p.duty/INC12345. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/gpu-oom

alice (on-call): Acked. I'll take this one. @Ben SRE can you join? I'll start triage on metrics and logs.

Ben SRE: On it. Quick check: `kubectl -n infer logs rtime-infer-42 | tail -n 40` shows repeated errors: `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY at /allocator/allocator.cc:142` and `nvml: memory fragmentation` — looks like KV cache growth + fragmentation.

Carla (ML Runtime): Seeing p50->p99 token latency spike for gpt-medium-int8 in west2. Also memory churn on nodes. Recommend fallback to `gpt-medium-compact` and enable cpu-spill for long sequences. Can trigger route change.

Emma (Product): Noted customer impact — support tickets from 2 enterprise customers (org-128, org-214) with 500s. Adding status banner.

Dave (Support): I've opened DMs with both customers, collecting request ids and timestamps. Passing logs to CS.

alice (on-call): Mitigation plan (short):
1) throttle new requests to redwood/gpt-medium-int8 in west2 (reduce QPS by ~30%)
2) enable fallback to redwood/gpt-medium-compact for non-streaming requests
3) attempt to scale pool +2 GPUs (if zone capacity), else cross-zone spin-up
4) enable cpu-spill=true on affected nodes and reduce kv retention from 30m->5m
Applying step 1 now.

incident-bot: Action applied: route throttle by alice (on-call). routeset id=9876. PD note updated: https://p.duty/INC12345/notes/1

Ben SRE: Scale request: `scale pool infer-west2a-gpu-pool --add 2` returned error `Insufficient capacity in zone`. Initiating spin-up in west2b and cross-region reroute for overflow.

Carla (ML Runtime): Applied fallback policy for non-streaming: `route.set(fallback_model="redwood/gpt-medium-compact")`. Also reduced KV cache retention: `sysctl -w kv.cache_retention=300` on nodes in pool.

alice (on-call): Monitoring: 5m error rate dropped from 5.2% -> 1.1%. p99 token latency still ~2300ms but trending down.

Emma (Product): Status page updated: "Degraded performance in west2; mitigations in progress." Support notified.

Dave (Support): Customer A confirmed degraded but acceptable with fallback. Customer B requested an SLA note; escalated to CS.

Ben SRE: Deeper logs: recurring OOM in `rtime-infer` with trace snippet:
```
2026-03-17T15:12:03Z rtime-infer[pid:2312] ERROR CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY device=0 allocator.cc:142
stack: cudaMalloc->allocator::alloc->kv_cache::reserve
```
Also NVML shows fragmentation rather than steady full usage -> possible driver-level fragmentation + aggressive kv prefetch. Plan: drain problematic nodes, reprovision with driver 525.60 and newer kernel.

Carla (ML Runtime): Opening INF ticket for KV eviction tuning + per-request kv caps. Will add action item to postmortem to test kv retention defaults.

alice (on-call): Handoff: Ben + Carla own remediation and RCA. I'll stay on until error rate <0.5% for 30m, then close. Ping me if you need a fresh handoff. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty: Pager acknowledged by alice (on-call) at 3287654340

incident-bot: Closing summary: temporary routing/fallback applied, cross-zone spin-up attempted, kv retention reduced, cpu-spill enabled. Customer impact reduced. Created follow-up ticket INF-2026 with mitigation steps (driver upgrade, kv eviction tuning, model routing safeguards). Thread closed; transfer to SRE/ML teams for full RCA and long-term fixes.
